recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered portrait where the subject's face is constructed from overlapping, semi-transparent legal documents and court dockets. The central figure is rendered in a coarse black-and-white halftone dot pattern, set against a vibrant, saturated orange background that features further document textures and high-contrast secondary portraits.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject features as a vessel for the background document texture.
High-contrast black-and-white foreground against a saturated orange field.
Juxtaposition of human features with rigid bureaucratic grids and tables.
Rough, torn-edge paper aesthetic creating a sense of urgency and grit.
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone/dithered texture on all photographic elements.
Saturated orange (#FF6600 range) as the primary background color.
Overlapping grid-based document layouts with visible table borders.
Black redaction bars or heavy black blocks used as graphic accents.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered close-up portrait occupying 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the central figure, which are clear and aligned despite the document overlay.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the central eyes outward to the surrounding document text, then to the high-contrast orange corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'maximalist' with texture filling every corner.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Halftone dots, text, and redaction bars)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Paper White/Light Grey (Document backgrounds and highlights in the face)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the flat, high-saturation orange and the desaturated, textured grayscale portrait.

letterConstructionRules: Monospaced typewriter styles for data entries
Bold, condensed sans-serif for display headers
Heavy ink-bleed or xerox-distortion on smaller text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Text is often clipped or obscured by overlapping layers
Some characters appear dithered into the halftone pattern
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Functional bureaucratic pairing: Bold display sans-serif paired with utilitarian monospaced and tabular serif fonts.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed display feel.
Matches the monospaced document data look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast collage background using a vibrant orange base. Layer grayscale, high-contrast images of legal dockets, tables, and forms with torn edges. Include a large central portrait of a man rendered in a coarse black-and-white halftone dot pattern, making the face appear as if it is printed onto the documents.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed slab-serif display text in the lower left and clean sans-serif headers at the top. Use black redaction bars to block out sections of the background document text to create visual rhythm.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible and coarse?
Is the orange background highly saturated?
Are the document grids and tables clearly visible through the portrait?
Is the text rendered with a distressed, printed-matter quality?

mustRedesign: Specific names and case numbers on documents
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone dots don't muddy the facial features.
Check that the orange doesn't lean too yellow or red.
Verify the 'torn paper' edges look organic and not computer-generated.
Confirm the text looks like it belongs to a physical document.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layer [Subject Portrait] + [Halftone Filter] + [Orange Background] + [Scanned Document Overlays] + [Redaction Bars] + [Bold Slab-Serif Typography].
